description: Data on the unpaid toll fees is a dataset listed in NSW Government open data portal (data.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Customer Service. Released under formal Government Information Public Access (GIPA) Application to Department of Finance, Services and Innovation (DFSI) - FA35 15-16 "The following information for each of Sydney's Motorways, that is a. ) the M5 Motorway, b. ) the M2 Motorway, c. ) the Cross City Tunnel, d. ) the M7 Westlink Motorway, e. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Customer Service. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2017-01-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-nsw.
